title: Pure Cupid
summary: An optimized Cupid deck integrating The Agent engine (Venus, Earth, Neptune) and Diviner of the Herald to fuel Cupid Pitch Synchro ladders and Rank 2 Xyz plays. By modulating Levels with Cupid Volley, Cupid Serve, and Cupid Fore, the deck accesses Level 7 through 11 Synchro bosses like F.A. Dawn Dragster, Draco Berserker of the Tenyi, Masterflare Hyperion, Chengying, Chaos Angel, and Psychic End Punisher, while Neptune and Hop Ear Squadron provide 600 DEF searchable extenders and surprise disruptions.

allow.Diviner of the Herald: 1-card Synchro starter; dumps Trias Hierarchia or Elder Entity N'tss to destroy a card.
allow.The Agent of Creation - Venus: Generates 3x Lv 2 bodies for Synchro climbing.
allow.Mystical Shine Ball: Level 2 Fairy Normal Monster summoned by Venus.
allow.The Agent of Life - Neptune: 600 DEF; searchable off Pitch! Revives Dunk/Venus with Kaiju/Tribute immunity.
allow.The Agent of Mystery - Earth: Searches Venus/Neptune; Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Tuner.
allow.Trias Hierarchia: Diviner dump target; makes Diviner Lv 11 for Cupid Fore to copy + Quick Effect pop.
allow.Buten: Turns any Lv 4 or lower LIGHT Fairy into a Tuner from the GY.
allow.Hop Ear Squadron: Searchable off Pitch; turns a Lv 8–10 Cupid Dunk into a surprise Synchro on opponent's turn.
allow.Forbidden Droplet: Protects Dunk from effect negation while halving ATK.
allow.Piri Reis Map: Searches Diviner of the Herald, Cupid Volley, or Agent Neptune.
allow.The Sanctuary in the Sky: Optional 1-of searched if Neptune is banished by Cupid Serve's GY effect.
allow.Celestial Double Star Shaman: Lv 2 Synchro Tuner; mass-revives Shine Balls and Cupid Serve.
allow.Elder Entity N'tss: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Fusion sent to the GY by Diviner of the Herald to destroy 1 card on the field and boost Diviner to Level 6.
allow.Martial Metal Marcher: Lv 3 Synchro Tuner; revives Cupid Pitch from GY.
allow.Old Entity Hastorr: Lv 4 Synchro; great Hop Ear target with Lv 2 Cupid Serve.
allow.F.A. Dawn Dragster: Lv 7 Synchro S/T negate; scales its own Level for Cupid Fore.
allow.Masterflare Hyperion: Lv 10 LIGHT Fairy Synchro; gives Cupid Fore a Lv 10 body to copy onto Dunk.
allow.Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying: Lv 10 Synchro; triggers every time Cupid Serve banishes from GY!
allow.Chaos Angel: Lv 10 Synchro; whole board becomes unaffected by monster effects.
allow.Psychic End Punisher: Lv 11 Synchro; synergizes with Venus paying 1500 LP and Volley gaining 1500 LP.
allow.Herald of Pure Light: Rank 2 LIGHT Fairy Xyz made with Mystical Shine Balls that detaches 1 material to recover a monster from the GY.
allow.Lyna the Light Charmer, Lustrous: Link-2 LIGHT monster that steals a LIGHT monster from the opponent's GY.
